scope: Fresh real-scanner preparation, load, analysis, verified-MIR lowering and C emission in one Go process. GetProcessTimes user+kernel CPU covers all process threads. Explicit Go GC runs before every timed build and automatic GC is disabled throughout this test; GC outside the intervals and native MSVC work are excluded. Four builds per lane per pair reduce but do not eliminate the observed 15.625 ms clock quantization. This is a GC-excluded compiler-work screen, not complete build time, normal-GC check latency or an independent-C verdict.
